linuxSetup.installDescription: Installs Debian and the Paseo daemon on this phone
linuxSetup.updateDescription: Paseo {{version}} is being installed inside Linux
linuxSetup.backgroundHint: You can leave the app. Setup continues in the background
linuxSetup.failedDescription: Setup stopped at "{{step}}". Retry starts that step again.
linuxSetup.cancelledDescription: Setup was stopped at "{{step}}". Retry continues from that step.

checkingSlow.title: Still checking Linux
checkingSlow.description: This is taking longer than usual. You can start Linux yourself or look at the logs.

startFailed.title: Linux didn't start
startFailed.description: Linux is installed but failed to start. Restart it, or continue and connect to another host.

linux.title: Linux
linux.info: Linux runs in a foreground service. Stopping it stops the daemon, SSH and every agent on this phone.

stopConfirm.title: Stop Linux?
stopConfirm.message_one: The daemon, SSH and {{count}} running agent on this phone will stop.
stopConfirm.message_other: The daemon, SSH and {{count}} running agents on this phone will stop.
stopConfirm.messageIdle: The daemon and SSH on this phone will stop.

keepAwake.title: Keep awake with screen off
keepAwake.hint: Holds a wake lock so agents keep working. Uses more battery.

battery.title: Battery optimization is on
battery.description: Android may still stop Linux in the background.

phantom.title: Android may stop Linux processes
phantom.description: Turn on "Disable child process restrictions" in Developer options, or run: adb shell settings put global settings_enable_monitor_phantom_procs false

notifications.title: Notifications are off
notifications.description: Linux keeps running, but its status and Stop button won't show in the notification shade.

reinstall.title: Reinstall Linux
reinstall.hint: Deletes Linux and installs it again
reinstall.confirmMessage: Kept: this host's registration, the SSH host key and authorized keys. Deleted: everything else in /root, including projects and installed agents. The exchange folder on the phone is kept.

remoteAccess.title: Remote access
remoteAccess.info: Desktops connect over SSH. Paseo desktop tunnels to the daemon through the same connection, so the daemon is never exposed on the network.

network.title: Network
network.noneDescription: Connect to Wi-Fi or start Tailscale.

sshOff.title: SSH server is off
sshOff.description: Turn it on in Linux above.

desktop.title: Paseo desktop
desktop.hint: Add host › Remote SSH, then paste

hostKey.title: Host key
hostKey.hint: Match this when a desktop connects for the first time

noKeys.title: No authorized keys yet
noKeys.description: Desktops sign in with a key. Add your desktop's public key (for example ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub) first.

keys.title: Authorized keys
keys.removeMessage: {{comment}} will no longer be able to sign in. The SSH server restarts, so open SSH sessions are disconnected.
keys.privateKey: This is a private key. Paste the .pub file instead.

exchange.title: Exchange folder
exchange.info: One shared folder for moving files in and out of Linux. Keep projects in your Linux home folder, not here.

permission.title: Storage access needed
permission.description: Linux needs file access to see this folder. Android grants it for all shared storage, so every program inside Linux can read, change and delete your photos, downloads and documents.

restartRequired.title: Restart Linux to finish
restartRequired.description: Storage access is on. Linux sees the folder after it restarts.

exchange.mountFailed: Unable to mount the exchange folder

linuxStopped.title: Linux is stopped
linuxStopped.description: Agents on this phone are offline
